expect.header: Themes that pair well with lamb imagery
expect.bodytext:

  • Reflection, patience, and slower movement.

_context.pageTitle: Lambs, Meadows, and the Meaning of Easter

expect.bodytext: Lambs bring together several Easter themes at once: spring, tenderness, renewal, and quiet attention. Even without explicit symbolism, images of sheep and open meadows suggest a gentler pace and a season beginning again. That is why they continue to appear in Easter storytelling across both religious and cultural settings.
